one_liner: Work management platform to organize, track, and manage team projects and tasks.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth 2.0, Personal Access Tokens (PAT), and Service Accounts for enterprise tiers.
access_notes: Free developer account and personal access tokens available out of the box.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering tasks, projects, workspaces, portfolios, and webhooks at https://app.asana.com/api/1.0
blocker_notes: Fully accessible with public developer docs, self-serve tokens, and an official MCP server.

auth.quote: Asana’s API has several options for authenticating. The purpose of your app, who uses it, and its features will dictate the method of auth that’s best for your app.

access.quote: Before using the API explorer, be sure to create a personal access token (if you do not already have one). Generating a PAT allows you to access (i.e., make requests to) the Asana REST API upon successful authentication.

api.quote: Asana's REST API reference allows you to explore different REST API endpoints through an in-context, easy-to-use interface.

mcp.quote: The V2 MCP server (https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp) requires OAuth 2.0 authentication with a registered client ID and client secret.

verdict.quote: Integrate tools, automate actions, and customize your workflows with Asana’s developer platform.
